Agent Name: Planner

Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted a search snippet and prematurely concluded that the album Current Mood was released on February 17, 2017—the radio release date of the single "Small Town Boy"—without cross-checking authoritative sources. This led to providing the wrong album release date; the correct album release date is September 8, 2017.
